74c193ea767f: Travelife's partners include the three major GDSs: Amadeus, Sabre and Galileo Travelport. 8ed173ccf8bc: How many airlines and accommodations can I access with Travelife?
a712d8d0622e: Travelife gives access to more than 1,500 airlines and 500,000 accommodations. This inventory is the result of hundreds of connections built since 2013 with hospitality and transport suppliers: GDSs, aggregators, hotel wholesalers and ferry companies. Agencies check availability and rates in real time, then book from the same platform, without juggling multiple supplier extranets.
140c47b11f28: Which hotel wholesalers partner with Travelife?
87041c36cb81: Travelife's accommodation and activity partners include Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Jumbobeds, Jumbo Tours, GTA Travel, Restel, TravelClick, Expedia, MyHotels, TBO.com, RezLive and Viator. Thanks to these connections, Travelife brings multiple suppliers' inventory together in a single flow: the agency compares rates, applies its margins and sells alongside its own hotel contracts. For ferry transport, Travelife also works with GNV, Baleària and Trasmediterránea.
01826cd56959: Which online payment solutions are compatible with Travelife?
e1033073c0c1: Travelife's payment partners include CMI, Payzone, PayPal, Fatourati and Binga, allowing agencies to collect online bookings by local or international bank card. These integrations power the B2C website in particular, which accepts full payment, an online deposit or a simple quote request.
